noc_firewall_api.h

Read and write one Network-on-Chip (NoC) firewall aperture.

The calls without a base address use the platform firewall base and return -ENOSYS when that base is missing or zero. target is the aperture offset socfpga_noc_firewall_target_t. A NULL output pointer or an unknown offset returns -EINVAL from the driver. The *_with_base calls return -EINVAL for a zero base_address as well.

noc_firewall_api_get
int32_t noc_firewall_api_get(
socfpga_noc_firewall_target_t 
target,
uint32_t 
*
value
)

Read one firewall aperture at the platform base.

Parameters
target
socfpga_noc_firewall_target_t

Aperture selector.

value
uint32_t*

Receives the register value. Must be non-NULL.

Returns

0 on success. -ENOSYS when the platform base is missing or zero. -EINVAL when value is NULL or target is out of range.

Read one firewall aperture at base_address. Does not substitute the platform base.

Parameters

Firewall MMIO base. Zero is rejected.

Receives the register value. Must be non-NULL.

Returns

0 on success. -EINVAL when value is NULL, base_address is 0, or target is out of range.

noc_firewall_api_allow_nonsecure
int32_t noc_firewall_api_allow_nonsecure(
socfpga_noc_firewall_target_t 
target
)

Write the allow-non-secure policy for target at the platform base.

Does not read the aperture back. Bridge targets receive the bridge policy value; other targets receive the L4 policy value.

Parameters
target
socfpga_noc_firewall_target_t

Aperture selector.

Returns

0 on success. -ENOSYS when the platform base is missing or zero. -EINVAL when target is out of range.
